notablePrerequisites:
Seeker of Skybreak and Circle of Dreams Druid do not have summoning sickness.
You control at least three creatures.
description:
Activate Circle of Dreams Druid by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Seeker of Skybreak by tapping it, targeting itself.
Rings of Brighthearth triggers, causing you to pay {2} to copy Seeker of Skybreak's ability, targeting Circle of Dreams Druid.
Resolve both Seeker of Skybreak abilities, untapping it and Circle of Dreams Druid.
Repeat.
